fusions.name: Bite Above Your Weight
fusions.desc: A deep bite that deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Borrowed Roar
fusions.desc: Roars through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, knocking everything in it back 3 tiles and leaving them [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Play Dead
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cornered Bristle
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
